notes_for_editor: Only two sources: OpenStreetMap node 357997128 (tags; version 3, changeset 162625201) and an ExpertGPS download page of Mississippi towers (name only). The node's history shows an 'Add/modify tower' edit tagged #maproulette, which suggests the tags may come from a bulk tower-mapping task rather than from a lookout record. Hamilton is also a census-designated place in Monroe County (Wikipedia, read only as a lead and not cited; GNIS feature 670857 at 33.74 N, 88.41 W). The tower point is about 75 km from that place, so the name link is not shown. Searches and the NHLR Mississippi index (65 registered lookouts; this name is not in it) found no build date, owner, staffing or condition. Record county is null and the story names no county. Suggested checks: Mississippi Forestry Commission records, and recent aerial imagery.
